# Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit

The files in `src/` are OpenAI DevKit sources from [commit 0a36fef](https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit/tree/0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a/packages/local). LUMEN changes the local import specifiers for Turbopack and marks the affected files. The included DevKit Noncommercial License and third-party notices apply to these files.
